Add JWT authentication and OpenAPI documentation

- Add JWT secret config and decoder to AppState
- Require Authorization: Bearer <token> for all /api/* routes
- Implement JWT middleware and session extractor
- Add OpenAPI documentation using utoipa and ReDoc
- Annotate API schemas and endpoints for OpenAPI/Swagger
- Update .env example files for JWT config
- Add tests for JWT-protected API endpoints
- Regenerate TypeScript types with schema docs
